title: Inventory every baseline tool and upgrade
acceptance: Verified manifest records every base-game item, variant, acquisition path, cost and owning implementation task; excludes fan fiction and expansion-only entries.

title: Inventory badges, ranks and achievements
acceptance: Every baseline family and unlock edge has an explicit source, counting rule and retained/adapted decision.

title: Inventory encounters, civilizations and endgame
acceptance: Every baseline mission/event/civilization/endgame class maps to an implementation task.

title: Record reference interaction contracts
acceptance: Surface, system, galaxy, contact, shop, collections and menu behavior have annotated reference evidence.

title: Record scope exceptions and deferred creation tools
acceptance: Gopher adaptation, original IP, Marks, inventory packs and editor/expansion exclusions are explicit; no silent omissions.

title: Close the feature-to-task coverage matrix
acceptance: Every verified reference entry has exactly one owning task or explicit scope exception; unresolved evidence remains visible.

title: Unify entity identity and ownership references
acceptance: Stable IDs distinguish species, nation, system, planet, colony, ship and item across all modes.

title: Create one authoritative personal ship record
acceptance: Flight and strategy use the same location, equipment, hull, energy and orders; scene transitions never substitute another ship.

title: Create one inventory and account ledger
acceptance: All local/strategic inventory and Marks transactions address one authoritative ledger with separate owners and stores.

title: Unify time and background simulation
acceptance: Every colony, route, travel leg and timer advances once through the same fixed-tick clock and pause policy.

title: Centralize validated commands
acceptance: Player, AI and UI use commands that reject invalid actions atomically and emit clear failure reasons.

title: Create a shared durable event stream
acceptance: Events have stable IDs, actors, subjects, times and outcomes; consumers deduplicate across reloads.

title: Unify versioned saves and migration
acceptance: One snapshot restores the complete game; old local/strategic saves have an explicit migration or import decision.

title: Separate deterministic random streams
acceptance: Identical seed and commands reproduce gameplay; cosmetic randomness cannot change simulation outcomes.

title: Define validated content schemas
acceptance: Definitions for tools, species, goods, factions and events validate IDs, references, constraints and schema versions.

title: Budget AI scheduling and explanations
acceptance: Offscreen decisions run within bounded budgets and record reasons; no per-citizen or per-organism world simulation.

title: Generate connected sector and galaxy topology
acceptance: Seeded systems, star classes, planetary orbits and special locations form a navigable persistent galaxy beyond the authored 12-node fixture.

title: Implement personal system-to-system travel
acceptance: The actual ship traverses known/unknown systems and updates the authoritative location.

title: Implement system-to-planet transitions
acceptance: Entering/leaving planets preserves ship state and uses system navigation instead of a local surface chart.

title: Enforce drive range and travel energy
acceptance: Drive level, destination range and energy constrain travel; invalid travel spends nothing and recovery remains possible.

title: Persist exploration and knowledge fog
acceptance: Visited, detected, surveyed and unknown knowledge are distinct and survive transitions/reloads.

title: Implement scanners and signal detection
acceptance: Radar, planet scan and civilization detection reveal appropriate facts/signals without leaking unknown content.

title: Implement wormhole access and traversal
acceptance: Appropriate equipment permits stable wormhole travel with correct endpoints, arrival and restrictions.

title: Implement core-region access constraints
acceptance: Core geography, range constraints and hostile territory form a traversable strategic challenge.

title: Implement return-home travel capability
acceptance: The return capability has explicit acquisition, cost/cooldown and safe authoritative arrival behavior.

title: Implement destination selection and route validation
acceptance: Travel requests validate access, reach and destination existence; cancellation or interruption preserves location correctly.

title: Finish direct ship steering
acceptance: Arrows/numpad and mouse-supported steering work predictably on all local planet/orbit scenes.

title: Finish altitude and zoom interaction
acceptance: Zoom, ascent and descent have understandable scale transitions and cancellation across supported planets.

title: Finish camera framing and rotation
acceptance: Near/far views, free rotation and target framing remain useful without clipping or abrupt jumps.

title: Unify approach, stop and operation orders
acceptance: Manual steering, new targets, stop and cancellation resolve one active order without stale operations.

title: Handle collision and terrain clearance
acceptance: Ship movement and approach avoid terrain/planet intersections and unreachable target traps at all scales.

title: Finish world targeting and tool application input
acceptance: Selecting equipment never fires it; world/target clicks dispatch the correct command and invalid targets explain failure.

title: Implement configurable bindings and pointer accessibility
acceptance: Bindings persist and support left-handed pointer use without mandatory WASD/F; conflicts are detected.

title: Preserve pause, focus and modal input semantics
acceptance: Menus/inspection/focus loss block gameplay correctly and preserve prior pause/order state.

title: Persist reusable planet recipes
acceptance: Seed, environment and geography version generate stable planets for all reference-frame views.

title: Generate visitable terrain from globe geography
acceptance: Landing regions and visible globe features agree; terrain streams or uses bounded LOD without a single repeated arena.

title: Maintain geographic coordinates and anchored sites
acceptance: Cities, resources and markers remain attached to the same planet coordinates during rotation and view changes.

title: Model physical planet conditions
acceptance: Atmosphere, temperature and environmental hazards have deterministic values and actual gameplay effects.

title: Place resources, sites and discoveries spatially
acceptance: Seeded placements respect world conditions and remain persistent and physically approachable.

title: Represent non-landable and special world types
acceptance: Moons, unsuitable bodies and special planets have explicit behavior and navigable context; not every sphere pretends to be landable.

title: Expose measured planet information
acceptance: Queries distinguish unknown from scanned geography, ownership, conditions and known sites.

title: Generalize equipment command definitions
acceptance: Every verified tool family binds to a real validated handler with targets, costs, cooldowns and view restrictions.

title: Track tool ownership and acquisition
acceptance: Installed, owned, charged, passive and undiscovered equipment states are distinct; acquisition changes actual capabilities.

title: Implement shared cargo capacity and stacks
acceptance: Specimens, goods, artifacts and consumables have identity, count, capacity and provenance; remote stock is never cargo aboard.

title: Apply passive ship upgrade tiers
acceptance: Hull, energy, cargo, drive and other verified passive levels alter real limits and obey prerequisites.

title: Integrate finite ship energy
acceptance: Tools, defenses and travel consume one energy pool; no passive recharge or free transition refill.

title: Integrate hull damage, repair and defeat recovery
acceptance: Damage, consumable/service repair and costly recovery persist across worlds and cannot duplicate/reset resources.

title: Implement charged ship consumables
acceptance: Energy/repair items consume actual stock once, apply bounded effects and enforce restrictions/cooldowns.

title: Implement physical collection and deployment tools
acceptance: Tractor/abduction/drop operations transfer valid specimens, goods and artifacts between world and hold with correct ownership consequences.

title: Implement recharge and repair provider services
acceptance: Real docking/contact providers quote service costs; homeworld recharge is free and foreign prices genuinely apply during travel.

title: Implement defensive ship abilities
acceptance: Shielding, cloaking and verified defensive abilities have acquisition, energy upkeep and actual encounter effects.

title: Implement remaining exploration utility tools
acceptance: Verified scout/projection and other non-combat utility tools perform their distinct operations; no inert unlocks.

title: Generalize damageable combat actors
acceptance: Ships, buildings and other valid targets expose coherent health, allegiance and hit rules; invalid/friendly targets are handled explicitly.

title: Implement direct-fire weapon families
acceptance: Baseline beams/blasters and tiers differ mechanically in range, damage, energy and cooldown.

title: Implement guided and projectile weapon families
acceptance: Missiles and other baseline projectiles track/collide correctly and obey target, resource and upgrade rules.

title: Implement area and planetary bombardment weapons
acceptance: Bombing and area damage affect valid targets with bounded simulation and ownership consequence events.

title: Implement local hostile tactics
acceptance: Enemies detect, pursue, attack, disengage and select targets without one-script-only encounter behavior.

title: Recruit and instantiate allied escorts
acceptance: Eligible allies supply persistent escorts subject to rank capacity and replacement rules.

title: Implement escort formation and combat orders
acceptance: Escorts follow, attack designated targets, avoid hazards and retreat without unbounded pathfinding.

title: Persist escort damage and losses
acceptance: Destroyed/dismissed/recalled escorts update fleet and diplomatic state exactly once.

title: Implement combat retreat and encounter termination
acceptance: Escape, surrender/disable and victory have defined outcomes without resetting health, enemies or loot.

title: Implement stationary and colony defense combat
acceptance: Defensive actors target invaders and resolve damage through the common combat model.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Model territory and sovereignty
acceptance: Nation ownership, homeworlds, colonies and shared-planet claims are explicit and separate from species identity.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Implement AI expansion and settlement decisions
acceptance: Empires choose affordable reachable expansion and develop persistent holdings.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Implement war and peace state
acceptance: Declarations, hostility and peace change permissions and surviving obligations with durable causes.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Schedule and resolve raids and invasions
acceptance: Strategic actors choose real targets, commit bounded forces and resolve offscreen/onscreen consistently.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Implement conquest and ownership transfer
acceptance: Defeated or purchased holdings transfer production, structures and obligations without duplication or orphaned IDs.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Implement pirate and non-state threats
acceptance: Pirate raids/interceptions have origins, targets, consequences and mitigation independent of normal empire war.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Implement a core-region antagonist equivalent
acceptance: An original antagonist has persistent territory, distinctive diplomacy/combat rules and alternative interaction paths.

category: Empire territory, warfare and strategic AI
title: Resolve empire elimination and surviving relationships
acceptance: Loss of final holdings updates ownership, treaties, trade, fleets and event history consistently.

title: Implement first contact and speaker identity
acceptance: Contact resolves the actual nation/representative and unlocks only appropriate interactions.

title: Implement relationship memory and grievances
acceptance: Actions create explained modifiers, durations and thresholds; species/nation/planet are not conflated.

title: Implement NPC philosophy preferences
acceptance: Verified philosophy families change diplomatic decisions, access and reactions through data-driven rules.

title: Implement gifts, demands and tribute
acceptance: Offers/demands transfer real value and create appropriate relationship outcomes and refusals.

title: Implement alliances and non-aggression obligations
acceptance: Agreements grant access and responsibilities, can be broken and affect later decisions.

title: Implement trade permission and embargo diplomacy
acceptance: Agreements/embargoes change trade access and persist with visible causes; commodity movement belongs to TRD.

title: Implement negotiated system purchase
acceptance: Eligible diplomatic buyouts transfer real Marks and invoke the single sovereignty-transfer operation.

title: Implement embassies and normal social influence tools
acceptance: Verified social tools have costs, valid recipients, duration and political consequences.

title: Implement hire/attack requests and alliance responses
acceptance: Diplomatic requests cause actual accepted/refused strategic actions with costs and consequences.

title: Implement reputation consequences of exceptional actions
acceptance: Theft, prohibited weapons and hostile acts propagate justified reactions to affected nations.

title: Define baseline commodity economics
acceptance: Representative baseline goods have actual sources, stock, value and role; broader enrichment commodities are excluded here.

title: Implement market stock, demand and replenishment
acceptance: Offers draw on real stock/demand and cannot be farmed through unlimited repeat transactions.

title: Implement vendor quotes and pricing modifiers
acceptance: Local prices and services reflect provider and verified philosophy/consequence rules; displayed quotes match charged prices.

title: Implement atomic buy/sell transactions
acceptance: Quantity, capacity, stock, eligibility and affordability validate together before ledger mutation.

title: Implement equipment shop stock and ownership transitions
acceptance: Unlocked goods become purchasable, not free; purchase installs or stocks actual capabilities.

title: Integrate persistent trade routes
acceptance: Configured routes exchange real surplus within capacity/access/reserve rules while the player explores.

title: Track route maturity for economic acquisition
acceptance: Trade-route maturity exposes the correct system-buyout eligibility without itself transferring ownership.

title: Implement interruption and recovery of trade
acceptance: War, embargo, destroyed endpoints and shortages suspend/resume routes truthfully without creating stock.

title: Integrate colony founding with ship inventory
acceptance: A real colonization capability, cost and placement/timing decision establishes a persistent colony from personal flight.

title: Implement capacity and development limits
acceptance: Habitability, ownership and baseline colony slots constrain development and surviving structures.

title: Implement baseline city layout and building roles
acceptance: Factory/housing/entertainment-equivalent placement creates intelligible production/population/happiness tradeoffs.

title: Implement colony happiness and unrest
acceptance: Layout and loyalty modifiers affect population stability and vulnerability with explained causes.

title: Integrate colony output and storage
acceptance: Production fills finite local stores over simulation time; collection/trade consumes the same stock.

title: Implement development purchase and removal
acceptance: Building changes validate costs and refund/removal rules and persist across visits.

title: Implement colony support installations
acceptance: Verified storage, happiness/loyalty and support installations alter the intended local limits/rules.

title: Place and maintain defensive installations
acceptance: Colony defenses have acquisition/placement/maintenance records; firing behavior belongs to COM-10.

title: Implement complete habitability/T-score rules
acceptance: Temperature and atmosphere produce stable explicit tiers and expose ecological stabilization requirements.

title: Implement temperature-changing tool families
acceptance: Baseline heating/cooling operations and tiers consume resources and change actual planet conditions.

title: Implement atmosphere-changing tool families
acceptance: Adding/removing atmosphere and combined-effect tools change conditions with appropriate costs and durations.

title: Implement sustained and consumable terraforming behavior
acceptance: Temporary rates, permanent changes, drift and stabilization differ according to the verified tool definition.

title: Implement terrain sculpting operations
acceptance: Raise/lower/level and shaped terrain tools visibly alter navigable persistent terrain without corrupting sites.

title: Implement planet coloring and reset
acceptance: Ground/water/atmosphere palettes persist consistently across globe and surface and can be reset.

title: Implement planet destruction
acceptance: Destruction has resource/access restrictions and permanent world/ownership consequences; reactions consume its event.

title: Implement endgame world-restoration capability
acceptance: The earned late-game tool applies its verified environment/ecosystem effect with bounded charges and persistent results.

title: Define baseline species identities and roles
acceptance: Plant classes, herbivores and predators have sufficient representative species and valid habitat definitions.

title: Implement aggregate ecosystem population rules
acceptance: Species populations and interactions respond to climate, collection and deployment without individual-agent simulation.

title: Implement ecological stabilization of habitability
acceptance: Required species roles establish/maintain supported environmental tiers and fail meaningfully when removed.

title: Implement ecosystem collapse and species loss
acceptance: Unsuitable conditions and population removal have bounded, visible, reversible-or-permanent outcomes as specified.

title: Implement ecological protection and sanctuary effects
acceptance: Verified stabilizers/protectors/sanctuaries reduce the intended ecological risks and expose their operating limits.

title: Implement species manipulation tool effects
acceptance: Verified eradication/shuffling/size/manipulation operations change population or variants with actual costs and constraints.

title: Implement pre-space civilization world states
acceptance: Creature/tribal/civilization-level societies are discoverable states with appropriate interactions, not ordinary space empires.

title: Implement uplift/monolith progression
acceptance: Uplift changes a civilization over time into an actual contactable empire with coherent identity and consequences.

title: Implement badge counter definitions
acceptance: Every retained baseline family/tier maps to durable counting rules and explicit adaptations.

title: Implement deduplicated accomplishment counting
acceptance: Distinct actions count correctly; repeat load/build-delete/trade loops cannot fabricate advancement.

title: Implement master ranks and rank benefits
acceptance: Badge progress advances rank and changes the actual verified capabilities such as escort capacity.

title: Implement alternate unlock paths and prerequisites
acceptance: Eligibility evaluates OR/AND badge requirements and preceding upgrades independently from ownership and price.

title: Implement separate achievement records
acceptance: One-time achievements remain distinct from repeated badge tiers and survive reloads.

title: Tune peaceful and aggressive progression paths
acceptance: Both paths reach useful tools through consequential actions without compulsory delivery grinding.

title: Represent player archetype identity
acceptance: A scenario/choice establishes the player's baseline philosophy without requiring earlier Spore stages.

title: Implement verified consequence abilities
acceptance: Starting/archetype consequences affect their intended rules without hidden free advantages.

title: Implement each archetype-specific power
acceptance: Every retained unique power has its own verified cost, effect, restriction and feedback; it invokes shared domain primitives.

title: Implement philosophy-change progression
acceptance: A permitted conversion changes identity and available power through actual requirements and persistent results.

title: Implement physical artifact and rare-tool placement
acceptance: Scannable/collectible finds spawn persistently on appropriate worlds with unique collection identity.

title: Implement artifact sets and duplicate handling
acceptance: Collection membership, duplicate value and completion outcomes are distinct from cargo storage and badge counting.

title: Implement optional contract lifecycle
acceptance: Offer/accept/decline/complete/fail states track actual participants, deadlines, rewards and consequences.

title: Implement retained baseline contract objective types
acceptance: Verified exploration, collection, defense and other retained objectives read real domain outcomes; compulsory gopher grind is explicitly adapted.

title: Implement ecological and colony crisis events
acceptance: Threatening domain conditions create intelligible timed events with meaningful response and failure outcomes.

title: Implement ambient discovery and risk encounters
acceptance: Optional signals lead to bounded distinct interactions and rewards without repeating the same salvage script everywhere.

title: Implement core arrival and endgame reward
acceptance: Reaching the core triggers an original culmination and grants the actual earned capability exactly once.

title: Continue play after endgame milestones
acceptance: The galaxy and progress remain playable after core outcomes, including return travel and persistent consequences.

title: Approve and implement typography and visual hierarchy
acceptance: Fonts, sizing, contrast, spacing and information hierarchy meet user review at target displays; rejected ornament is not reused.

title: Finish tool palette and item-state interface
acceptance: Categories, pages, keys, hover names, counts, cooldowns and disabled/locked reasons reflect actual equipment without persistent unwanted captions.

title: Finish inventory and item-detail interface
acceptance: Real hold contents expose valid use/drop/sell/equip actions and capacity; remote stock stays separate.

title: Finish surface map and conditions interface
acceptance: Local chart appears only on surface; world conditions/ecosystem information and map markers reflect measured state.

title: Implement system and galaxy navigation screens
acceptance: Each scale presents its actual geography/range/access information and drives personal ship travel; no local terrain chart outside planets.

title: Implement expressive communications interface
acceptance: Contextual representatives support incoming/outgoing dialogue and actual diplomatic/service choices.

title: Implement shop and transaction interface
acceptance: Provider, prices, quantities, capacity, stock and eligibility are visible before purchase/sale and update from confirmed outcomes.

title: Implement badges and collections interface
acceptance: Earned/locked entries show tier progress, alternatives and routes to newly purchasable capabilities.

title: Implement contextual targeting and combat feedback
acceptance: World targets, invalid actions, range, damage and danger have readable visual states without firing on mere selection.

title: Implement prioritized messages and alerts
acceptance: Calls, crises, unlocks and failures are deduplicated and prioritized; important events can pause without constant interruption.

title: Finish Escape menu and nested settings
acceptance: Resume/save/load/settings/history/title are modal and preserve pause state; no permanent bottom utility rail.

title: Implement audio, display and input settings
acceptance: Volumes, subtitles, bindings and supported display/UI options persist and apply without breaking play.

title: Implement chronicle presentation
acceptance: One event history presents discovery, decisions, battles, losses and relations without revealing unknown facts.

title: Build coherent contextual onboarding
acceptance: The first session introduces flight, tools, energy, cargo, contact, purchases and progression in a playable sequence.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Establish the approved original art production kit
acceptance: Specifications, scale/material rules, import budgets and review samples define an accepted creepy-cute world; rejected styles remain documented.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Author the scout and representative ship kit
acceptance: Original all-angle meshes, materials, sockets and animation states support close/far flight and combat.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Author coherent planet and surface presentation
acceptance: Planet shading, atmosphere, geography, terrain, vegetation and lighting form believable consistent worlds rather than recolored noise.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Author baseline flora and fauna assets
acceptance: Representative ecological roles have original models, movement and readable scan/collection/deployment responses.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Author alien representatives and performances
acceptance: Baseline philosophy representatives have distinctive original silhouettes and dialogue/reaction animation.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Author colony and civilization asset kits
acceptance: Required buildings, settlements and development levels read clearly in surface/orbit views.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Author the approved icon and interface artwork
acceptance: Recognizable symbols and states support all baseline screens; temporary SVGs and rejected borders are not counted as final art.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Author and integrate gameplay effects
acceptance: Thrust, scanning, collection, weapons, terraforming, damage and discovery use bounded coherent effects with actual timing.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Produce and integrate approved sound effects
acceptance: Every meaningful interaction has an accepted licensed cue; rejected flight/UI sounds are replaced and loops are mixed in context.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Produce and integrate adaptive music
acceptance: Accepted licensed music supports exploration, diplomacy, danger and transitions with independent level control.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Produce contextual voice and alien vocalization
acceptance: Accepted performances, pronunciation, timing and captions replace rejected scratch narration.

category: Original art, animation and audio assets
title: Ground the stellar backdrop in documented data
acceptance: Licensed star positions/brightness and a declared observer frame produce a credible sky; random dots are not labeled accurate.

title: Implement ship assembly operations
acceptance: Allowed parts attach/transform symmetrically with valid connections, bounds and undo/redo.

title: Implement ship paint and material editing
acceptance: Editable finishes persist and preserve the readable approved art treatment.

title: Implement building assembly and paint
acceptance: Required building classes can be composed and colored within valid placement and performance constraints.

title: Persist and apply player creations
acceptance: Validated creation files save/load and appear in actual ships/colonies without changing unrelated mechanical stats.

title: Implement creator interaction screens
acceptance: Parts browsing, manipulation, camera, preview, undo and confirmation are usable and explain invalid edits.

title: Maintain reproducible model regression coverage
acceptance: Existing and new rules have meaningful deterministic/atomicity tests, with stable isolated fixtures and no player-save mutation.

title: Verify cross-view saves and uninterrupted simulation
acceptance: Multiworld play, mid-operation reload and migration preserve inventory, clocks, relationships and projects exactly once.

title: Verify native input and display accessibility
acceptance: Actual supported inputs, tooltips and dense screens are checked at 1080p+ with readable focus/contrast and no clipped controls.

title: Profile the full sector and simultaneous colonies
acceptance: Measured CPU/GPU/memory budgets include AI, traffic, effects and save/load on the development PC with background load recorded.

title: Playtest peaceful and hostile complete sessions
acceptance: Different progression paths reach endgame capabilities without repetitive mandatory errands or exploit-driven advancement.

title: Integrate baseline sandbox and deliberate cheats
acceptance: Sandbox uses the same ship/systems with separate saves and explicit cheats that do not contaminate normal progression.

title: Maintain reproducible desktop build pipeline
acceptance: Pinned engine builds a runnable Windows package and exported-pack smoke verifies resource loading.

title: Maintain verified off-device checkpoints
acceptance: Validated milestones are committed, pushed and remote hashes checked; builds and rejected drafts stay out of source control.

title: Validate clean-machine installation and recovery
acceptance: A packaged game runs without the workspace, reports failures and handles missing/corrupt saves or assets safely.

title: Close the final baseline parity audit
acceptance: Every reference entry passes its owning task's acceptance or has an explicit user-approved exception; no missing family is hidden by averages.

title: Expand flora/fauna and synergy corpus
acceptance: After baseline, author a broad distinct ecology corpus with rare traits and meaningful interactions; not counted as baseline completion.

title: Expand commodities, material culture and supply chains
acceptance: Additional resources, manufactured goods, cultural goods and cross-world production chains enrich the established economy.

title: Add visible resource investments and harvesting infrastructure
acceptance: Mines, farms, extraction and shipping visuals support expensive worthwhile investments beyond the baseline set.

title: Build the Vanguard and ancestor story campaign
acceptance: Living choices, fallible ancestors, varied invaders and meaningful consequences implement the authored campaign beyond baseline parity.

title: Add human Sol and variable story scenarios
acceptance: Separate human and alien starts plus replay variation use shared systems without contradicting fixed scenario history.

title: Deepen nations, governments and appointed administrators
acceptance: Political choices, mayors and governmental institutions extend baseline empire diplomacy and aggregate colonies.

title: Deepen SimCity-style services and development
acceptance: Wealth tiers, education, healthcare, service networks and regional specialization support space play without per-person simulation.

title: Add megafauna transport and unusual infrastructure
acceptance: Creature transit and original alien urban systems extend the accepted environment and aggregate network model.

title: Build first-person fleet combat and advanced orders
acceptance: Cockpit flight and richer fleet command are desired additions, not base Spore Space Stage parity.

title: Consider full creature creation and procedural animation
acceptance: Explicitly deferred; scope and separate estimate required before implementation or claiming creation parity.

title: Consider online creation sharing and moderation
acceptance: Not assumed in the single-player baseline; needs a separate product/security/moderation scope.

title: Account for Galactic Adventures and multiplayer exclusions
acceptance: Expansion adventure editors/missions and multiplayer are not current baseline commitments; record exclusion rather than claiming them complete.
